intent: Add truthful published-project proof cards to the case-study and guide hubs

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The live review found the two hubs visually text-led despite existing real portfolio proof.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Images should be large, purposeful, and never decorative stock.
visual_evidence.comparison: Current text-led hubs versus existing PublishedProjectProof with local portfolio poster.

brief.visitor: A search visitor deciding whether Esteban's work is relevant before selecting a case study or practical guide.
brief.promise: One real published project makes the source of the advice visible without getting in the way of the directory.
brief.primary_action: Open the named published portfolio project.
brief.friction: The hubs currently begin as credible reading pages but do not visually demonstrate the media work behind them.

kpi.decision_rule: retain only if the proof remains usable and produces meaningful navigation without a quality regression

concept.idea: A compact proof card drawn from the site's own published portfolio.
concept.brand_reason: Esteban sells media; a real frame should substantiate a reading hub.
concept.interaction: Tap/click opens the published project; hover adds a restrained scale/arrow response.
concept.visible_response: Poster and link remain clear; no autoplay or hidden content.
concept.direct_path: The directory and all existing links remain unchanged.
concept.alternatives: Do not use stock imagery, a video embed, or homepage-style hero treatment.

story.opening: The hub answers the visitor's question first.
story.action: The visitor sees and can open a relevant published project.
story.next_step: They can select a case/guide or start a project through existing paths.

content.visible: Existing title, existing project context, explicit project link.

references.borrow: Existing PublishedProjectProof component and portfolio poster resolution.
references.avoid: Stock imagery, invented outcomes, autoplay and generic visual decoration.

components.local_reason: The hub composes project-specific existing proof; no new shared component is necessary.

verification.accessibility_performance: keyboard focus, no overflow, no player/embed cost.
verification.raw_html: Proof title, link, and poster source present in server HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: No form action; existing delegated click event only.

learning.hypothesis: A real project preview helps search visitors recognise the work before choosing a reading path.
learning.decision_rule: retain if comparable hub visits show useful proof navigation without usability regressions; otherwise simplify or remove.
learning.registration_condition: Record the shipped event and comparable hub-visit baseline before outcome readout.
